issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: vine, iron_bars, red_wall_banner, moss_carpet, stone_brick_wall, mossy_cobblestone_wall, stone_brick_slab.

notes.detail: Adds vines on the front, moss carpet on the walk, a barrel, a mossy wall and a slab in the crenels.
notes.depth: Front has footing, corbels and slits; the inner (back, z2) face is a flat 5-high slab of brick with only cobble patches.
notes.roof: Joins checked against the shared profile (walk top y4 / stand y5, parapet y5, merlons at even x at y6): both open ends (x0, x4) carry the full body, an open 2-wide walk at z1-z2 and merlons at x0 and x4, so pieces join cleanly. Because the module is 5 wide, every join puts two merlons side by side (x4 + next x0); that is common to all stone_wall_* pieces, not a mismatch.

visual.summary: L2 plus weathering and use: vines down the front, moss carpet on the walk, a mossy cobblestone wall and a slab filling the crenels, and a barrel by the lamp post.
problems: None blocking. Barrel (x3 z2 y5) plus post (x2 z2) leave the walk 1 wide (z1) over x2-x3; fine for soldiers.
